title: Base64 encoder/decoder lookups use ISO-8859-1, corrupting non-Latin-1 text
property: decoding the base64 encoding of a string gives back the original string
expected: "\u20ac" (round trip preserved; UTF-8 is the library convention, as in the URL lookups)
actual: "?" because the encoder uses getBytes(ISO_8859_1), which replaces unmappable chars with '?'
evidence: INSTANCE_BASE64_ENCODER/DECODER in StringLookupFactory use StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1; the sibling URL lookups document and use UTF-8, and the encoder silently loses data for any char above U+00FF.
